subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel land this narrower run/harness/context bucket policy, or switch to the broader all-duration histogram policy represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098 before either branch merges?
rationale: Both PRs change exported metric aggregation defaults, but they make different scope and bucket-range choices that can affect existing operator dashboards and alerts.

options.title: Prefer a shared duration policy first
options.body: Update or select the branch that applies one intentional duration-bucket policy across the relevant millisecond OTel histograms, then require real export proof.

options.title: Accept this narrower policy
options.body: Merge this PR only if maintainers deliberately want run/harness/context buckets changed while leaving sibling duration histograms on OTel defaults.

options.title: Pause both overlapping PRs
options.body: Hold both branches until diagnostics owners settle the default bucket range and compatibility stance for exported metrics.

recommendation.title: Prefer a shared duration policy first
recommendation.body: Update or select the branch that applies one intentional duration-bucket policy across the relevant millisecond OTel histograms, then require real export proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent and historical diagnostics-otel metric ownership signal in blame, log, and GitHub commit metadata.
